english.title: Breach of sex offender order made in Northern Ireland
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, did an act, namely **(..SPECIFY ACT..), which you were prohibited from doing by a Sex Offender Order made in Northern Ireland under

(A)_[Article 6]_
(B)_[Article 6A]_

of the Criminal Justice (Northern Ireland) Order 1998 on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) by **(..SPECIFY COURT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 2B of the Crime and Disorder Act 1998.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without reasonable cause
do an act
you were prohibited from doing
by a Sex Offender Order made in Northern Ireland

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
THIS OFFENCE IS NOW OBSOLETE - now see H5840

(i) For the purposes of this offence, IT IS NOT OPEN to the court to make an order under section 12 of the Powers of Criminal Courts (Sentencing) Act 2000 (conditional discharge) in respect of the offence.
(ii) See Section 3(1) for definition of 'sex offender'.
(iii) See Section 3(6) and (7) for basis upon which defence may challenge.
(iv) Section 2B was inserted into the Crime and Disorder Act 1998 by section 69 of the Police Reform Act 2002.
(v) See also H1991 and H1992 for the offences where sex offender orders made in England or Wales and Scotland respectively are breached.
(vi) Repealed by s.140 of and Schedule 7 to the Sexual Offences Act 2003

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Five years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
